finding.detail: The current v1 probe uses tensor_digest() that converts tensors to float32 contiguous CPU bytes before hashing and does not include tensor shape in the digest envelope. The same function is used for clean/corrupted token-ID hashes. Those hashes are value-normalized digests, not general exact dtype+shape+payload tensor identities.
finding.counterhypothesis: For the currently selected Qwen-class vocabulary, token IDs are normally below the IEEE-754 float32 consecutive-integer limit, so float32 conversion alone may not collapse present token IDs. This does not close the protocol gap: shape is still not bound into the digest and dtype normalization is semantically incompatible with a claim of exact tensor identity.
finding.falsifier: If the current probe or another canonical envelope already binds original dtype, exact shape and exact pre-normalization payload bytes into the identity used by the receipt, this finding should be withdrawn. No such binding was observed in the inspected current source.

next_exact_gate: Integrate ENTITYOS_HCU_EXACT_TENSOR_IDENTITY/v1 into the current activation-probe successor so token IDs, named activations and bound logits carry exact dtype+shape+payload identity while any optional float32-normalized digest is separately labeled value-only; then execute focused regressions on an authorized zero-cost local normal-user or clay-direct-dev surface before any runtime promotion.
